whitespace_policy: ASCII and ideographic spaces use the blank fallback and do not consume atlas cells
preserved_set_scope: minimum UI digits and punctuation; Latin letters and other symbols are added automatically when they occur in Korean translations
overflow_policy: fail the fixed-atlas build and advance to the static two-bank hook PoC; do not shorten translations to fit

font_policy.oversize_fallback: retry the primary font at decreasing sizes down to 14 px

wobble_planes.rationale: match the stock 4-bitplane jitter animation selected by palettes 0-3
